item.title: 【UPSCALED】Madonna - True Blue (Remix Video) (4K Upscale)
item.description:
I did this around 2001, way before the "Celebration DVD" came out. Sourced from a Warner promo VHS, it features the international version of "True Blue". I replaced and synced the audio using the remix/edit, which back then was only available on CD on "32 Ones On One Radio 1's 25th Birthday", that's the source for the audio track.

Upscaled to 4K using the Iris model, a slight but overall good improvement over the original VHS image quality, notice the shoulder skin contour. I added a bit of grain, probably not a good decision but there it is.



Hope you enjoy it
